finding: API Gateway HTTP API private integration returned 33-byte 503 responses that never reached the application (no app log line).
change: Server keepAliveTimeout raised from the Node default 5000 ms to 120000 ms (server/src/app/httpTimeouts.ts).
method: Normal Cognito session; 1200 private GETs paced at 500 ms across five admin/registration reads; own session revoked (HTTP 204).
limitations: Zero failures in 1200 requests is consistent with the fix but not conclusive on its own at the prior 0.25% rate; continued access-log observation is required. Access logs do not record integration error detail.
